title: Dumped at 9 AM. Clocked in 9:05.
caption: Dumped at nine, back at the desk by five past? Busy isn't the same as better. Log off, give the feelings ten minutes, and let rest count as healing. Send this to the friend who answers emails mid-heartbreak.
